language.subtitle: You can change this anytime in Settings
welcome.body1: Nidhi shows where your hard-earned money goes — every day, every rupee.
welcome.body2: Set small goals. Set aside what you can. Watch it add up over time.
welcome.body3: Nidhi never shames you. It helps you notice, choose, and grow.
name.title: What should we call you?
name.subtitle: We'll use your name to greet you warmly.
financial.title: Your money picture
financial.subtitle: Tell us roughly where things stand. You can change these anytime.
financial.incomeHint: What you earn in a typical month
financial.savingsGoalHint: How much you'd like to set aside each month
financial.emergencyTargetHint: A small cushion for real emergencies
financial.emisHint: Add each loan separately so we can track what's due
summary.title: Looks good?
summary.subtitle: Here's everything you told us. Tap any field to edit it.
dashboard.emiExposureDesc: {percent} of your income is committed to EMIs
dashboard.emiExposureDescSafe: No EMIs logged yet — your income is fully yours to plan with
dashboard.noEntriesYet: No spending logged this month yet
log.title: Log spending
log.transcriptFailed: Couldn't transcribe — entry will still save without a note
log.aboveTypical: Above your typical {amount} — worth noting why
savings.title: Savings
savings.lockedDesc: Money you've committed to setting aside for discipline — your monthly goal.
savings.emergencyDesc: Reserved for real emergencies only. A small cushion to fall back on.
savings.howMuchSetAside: How much did you set aside?
savings.accessConfirmTitle: This is for a real emergency
savings.accessConfirmBody: Tapping this means you're withdrawing from your Emergency Fund. Make sure it's truly necessary.
savings.emergencyMilestone: You reached your emergency fund target
savings.trustedContactHint: A family member who gets a gentle heads-up when you access your Emergency Fund. Opt-in only.
insights.title: Insights
insights.noEntries: Not enough spending logged yet for insights. Log a few entries this week to see patterns here.
insights.obsHighCategory: You spent more on {category} {period} than the previous {period}.
insights.obsLowCategory: You spent less on {category} {period} than the previous {period}. Worth noting what changed.
insights.obsEmiHigh: Your EMI payments are now {percent}% of your logged monthly income.
insights.obsEmiSafe: Your EMI payments are a manageable {percent}% of your logged monthly income.
insights.obsSteady: Your spending pattern looks steady across categories.
insights.insuranceAwareness: An unexpected medical cost can undo months of savings — learning about low-cost health cover options is worth considering.
insights.disclaimer: Nidhi only describes your spending. It does not give financial advice.
settings.title: Settings
settings.voiceHint: Lets you record short voice context on spending entries. Optional — the app works fully without it.
settings.aboutBody: Nidhi is a financial discipline tool for everyday earners. It helps you see where your money goes and gently build savings. Nidhi does not connect to your bank, move real money, or give financial advice.
settings.resetConfirmBody: This will erase your name, financial picture, all logged entries, and savings. This cannot be undone.
notifications.dailyLogBody: A 2-minute check-in. Tap to log what you spent today.
notifications.largeExpenseBody: That was more than you typically spend on {category}. Worth noting why.
notifications.emiDueBody: Your EMI for {description} ({amount}) is due tomorrow.
notifications.savingsNudgeBody: Even ₹50 helps. Tap to mark it done.
notifications.emergencyMilestoneBody: You did it. Your emergency fund is now at your target. Well done.
voice.permissionBody: Nidhi needs your microphone to record voice notes. You can deny this and continue without voice notes — the app works fine.
voice.permissionDenied: Microphone permission denied. Voice notes are off; logging still works.
